source_engines: Gamecast extraction from the 22 marquee Week 4 games plus the Perplexity verification pass (official school box scores, ESPN game pages, Rotowire, Saturday Down South). Winner criteria: winning side, ranked opponent, verified line.

athlete_of_the_week.why: The sophomore from Macon went 27/38 for 360 yards and 3 touchdowns in the 31-24 win over No. 25 Missouri — Mississippi State's first ranked win of the season and the performance that moved him from 25-1 to +550 on the Heisman board in two weeks. No FBS quarterback threw for 400 yards in Week 4 (closest: Davis Warren, 396 vs Georgia Tech), which makes this the week's cleanest passing performance on a winning side against a ranked opponent.

photo.source: ESPN public CDN headshot (same pipeline as the site's team logos)

athlete_of_the_week.bio: 6-4, 230 pounds; Macon, Mississippi (Noxubee County HS). Mississippi State lists him as a sophomore with no redshirt designation — the school roster is the primary source over ESPN's 'FR' snippet.
athlete_of_the_week.verification: Line verified against the official Missouri box score and ESPN's game page — 27/38, 360 YDS, 3 TD, 1 INT, all five figures aligned (Sept 28 check).

runners_up.why: Four touchdowns without a turnover in a ranked team's blowout — held back only because the opponent is unranked.
Accounted for 400 total yards; the passing line alone misses the 400-yard cutoff by 35 yards.
